description: Static emitted arithmetic counts. +, - and * each count one. Explicit FMAs are listed separately: kFlops_ uses conventional FMA=2; kWeightedFlops_ uses FMA=1. Fused output accumulations are included in arithmetic, so only add the remaining listed standalone accumulations. Constant rational evaluation is compile time; geometry normalization/public validation and sqrt/division are excluded. No hardware-timing claim.

spherical.description: Exact live emitted arithmetic per lane, including geometry and output accumulation. Unary signs, copies, comparisons and selects cost zero. Division by square root costs eight. These weighted costs are not measured timings.

cartesian.description: Static emitted arithmetic counts. +, - and * each count one. Explicit FMAs are listed separately: kFlops_ uses conventional FMA=2; kWeightedFlops_ uses FMA=1. Fused output accumulations are included in arithmetic, so only add the remaining listed standalone accumulations. Constant rational evaluation is compile time; geometry normalization/public validation and sqrt/division are excluded. No hardware-timing claim.

m2l_comparison.description: Free-space M2L, including displacement geometry and additive output; source degree = FMM order - 2, local degree = FMM order - 1. Generic source dipoles are retained. The separate centered Cartesian column is valid only for zero source dipole. Application coordinate-unit conversion is excluded from both families. +, -, *, / and explicit FMA cost 1; sqrt costs 7. Both families emit explicit FMAs; no additional compiler contraction is assumed. These are emitted arithmetic counts, not measured instruction counts or timings.
